title: 2026 U.S. House election for New Mexico's 1st Congressional District
description: The 2026 general election for New Mexico's 1st Congressional District pits Democratic incumbent Rep. Melanie Stansbury against Republican nominee Ndidiamaka 'Didi' Okpareke. The district covers central New Mexico, including most of Albuquerque and eastern Bernalillo County, along with Torrance, Guadalupe, De Baca, and Lincoln counties. Stansbury, first elected in a 2021 special election, won re-election in 2024 with 56.4% of the vote, and the race is rated 'Solid D' by nonpartisan forecasters. Okpareke, a pharmacist and small business owner, is campaigning on healthcare access, fiscal responsibility, and economic development.
polling_note: No publicly available opinion polling was found for the NM-01 general election contest at this time.

candidates.name: Melanie Ann Stansbury
candidates.summary: Incumbent U.S. Representative for New Mexico's 1st Congressional District since 2021. A former state representative and science policy professional, Stansbury serves on the House Natural Resources Committee and has focused her career on water security, public lands conservation, and economic development. She holds a B.A. from Saint Mary's College of California and an M.S. in Development Sociology from Cornell University.

candidates.name: Ndidiamaka 'Didi' Okpareke
candidates.summary: Republican nominee for New Mexico's 1st Congressional District and a first-generation Nigerian-American. Okpareke is a pharmacist and business owner who founded Olive Tree Compounding Pharmacy in Rio Rancho. She campaigns on improving healthcare access, reducing federal spending, and fostering economic development to address poverty and crime in New Mexico.
